asOfNote: Custom equal-weight equity proxies for subsector beta and relative-alpha measurement. Individual equities only — not XLV/XBI/IBB/IHI/XPH or other broad ETFs as constituents. SMID Biotech membership is a liquid, XBI-style biotech set (typical SPDR S&P Biotech ETF names and specialist-owned clinical names), reconstructed by ticker rather than ETF holdings files.
rebalance: quarterly (conceptual; returns below are equal-weight averages of member total returns over each window, using completed daily bars)
limitations: Not Morgan Stanley or other sell-side baskets; constituents are a transparent research proxy.
Equal-weight overstates small names vs cap-weight sector beta.
EU Pharma uses liquid US-listed ADRs/ORDs; local European share classes are not included.
SMID Biotech is reconstructed from typical XBI-style liquid biotech names plus specialist-owned clinical names. It is not the official XBI holdings file, weights, or rebalance calendar.
CXO/CDMO/CRO mixes CROs, CDMOs, and related outsourced development/manufacturing; IQVIA sits here rather than in tools.
Payers, facilities, and physician/provider names are grouped as Hospitals / providers / insurance because they move with utilization and reimbursement beta, not drug pipelines.
Returns require a completed daily close for each member; missing members are dropped from that window and flagged.
